Skytruth Analysis
WEB REPORT/////THE BEAUMONT CHEMICAL PLANT EXPERIENCED SEVERE DAMAGE DUE TO HURRICANE RITA. ALL POWER AND UTILITIES WERE LOST, RESULTING IN AN OUTAGE OF THE BMCP STORAGE TANK VAPOR RECOVERY SYSTEMS FROM APPROXIMATELY 00:00 SEPTEMBER 23, 2005 UNTIL APPROXIMATELY OCTOBER 12, 2005. DURING THIS PERIOD, THE TANKS INTERMITTENTLY VENTED TO THE ATMOSPHERE VIA SAFETY RELIEF VALVES, AS ATMOSPHERIC TEMPERATURE CAUSED TANK PRESSURIZATION. DUE TO A COMPLETE LOSS OF THE DCS (BMCP PROCESS COMPUTER SYSTEM) DURING THIS PERIOD, THE EXACT DURATION OF EACH VENTING EPISODE CAN ONLY BE ESTIMATED. IT WAS ESTIMATED THAT, DURING THE PERIOD OF TIME NOTED ABOVE, APPROXIMATELY 29 POUNDS BENZENE WERE RELEASED PER 24 HOUR PERIOD. THE LOSS OF POWER AND THE RESULTING LOSS OF PROCESS FUNCTION ALSO CAUSED THE ETHYLENE UNIT REFRIGERATION SYSTEM TO SLOWLY VAPORIZED ETHYLENE AND PROPYLENE TO THE FLARE, GENERATING NITROGEN MONOXIDE (NO) UPON COMBUSTION. DUE TO A COMPLETE LOSS OF THE DCS (BMCP PROCESS COMPUTER SYSTEM) DURING THIS PERIOD, THE EXACT AMOUNT OF WEATHERING CAN ONLY BE ESTIMATED. IT WAS ESTIMATED THAT, DURING THE PERIOD FROM APPROXIMATELY 15:00 SEPTEMBER 29, 2005 UNTIL APPROXIMATELY 12:00 OCTOBER 11, 2005, APPROXIMATELY 20 POUNDS NITROGEN MONOXIDE (NO) WERE EMITTED PER 24 HOUR PERIOD.

DUE TO A COMPLETE LOSS OF THE DCS (BMCP PROCESS COMPUTER SYSTEM) DURING THIS PERIOD, THE EXACT DURATION OF EACH VENTING EPISODE CAN ONLY BE ESTIMATED. IT WAS ESTIMATED THAT, DURING THE PERIOD OF TIME NOTED ABOVE, APPROXIMATELY 29 POUNDS BENZENE WERE RELEASED PER 24 HOUR PERIOD. THE LOSS OF POWER AND THE RESULTING LOSS OF PROCESS FUNCTION ALSO CAUSED THE ETHYLENE UNIT REFRIGERATION SYSTEM TO SLOWLY VAPORIZED ETHYLENE AND PROPYLENE TO THE FLARE, GENERATING NITROGEN MONOXIDE (NO) UPON COMBUSTION. DUE TO A COMPLETE LOSS OF THE DCS (BMCP PROCESS COMPUTER SYSTEM) DURING THIS PERIOD, THE EXACT AMOUNT OF WEATHERING CAN ONLY BE ESTIMATED. IT WAS ESTIMATED THAT, DURING THE PERIOD FROM APPROXIMATELY 15:00 SEPTEMBER 29, 2005 UNTIL APPROXIMATELY 12:00 OCTOBER 11, 2005, APPROXIMATELY 20 POUNDS NITROGEN MONOXIDE (NO) WERE EMITTED PER 24 HOUR PERIOD.

REPORT DATE: 08-06-2024 REPORT TIME: 1209 UTC REGION: PACIFIC SUB REGION: CALIFORNIA AREA/BLOCK: N/A IMAGE DATE: 08-06-2024 IMAGE TIME: 0150 UTC DATA SOURCE: SENTINEL1A MODE: INTERFEROMETRIC WIDE (IW) VV RESOLUTION: 5X20 METER LOCATION: 34°01"01" N/118°39"47" W AREA: 24.18 SQUARE KILOMETERS CONFIDENCE: MEDIUM REPORT MAP/GIS FILES: HTTPS://WWW.OSPO.NOAA.GOV/PRODUCTS/OCEAN/MARINEPOLLUTION/ REMARKS: POSSIBLE OIL WAS OBSERVED IN SATELLITE IMAGERY. THIS ANOMALY IS UNCONFIRMED AS OIL. OFF THE COAST OF CENTRAL MALIBU (CALIFORNIA), THE SLICK WAS OBSERVED EMANATING FROM THE SHORE NEAR PARADISE COVE BEACH AND EXTENDED EASTWARDS 16.7 NMI ALONG THE COASTLINE, STOPPING ROUGHLY 1 NMI NORTH OF THE SANTA MONICA PIER. DUE TO THE LACK OF KNOWN OIL INFRASTRUCTURE IN THE AREA, CONFIDENCE WAS DETERMINED TO BE MEDIUM. UNCERTAINTIES: THE SLICK DISTINGUISHES ITSELF FROM TYPICAL NATURAL PHENOMENA DUE TO THE FACT THAT IT SEEMS TO BE EMANATING FROM A SPECIFIC POINT; PARADISE COVE BEACH. IN PARTICULAR, THERE IS A PIER LOCATED ON THE BEACH WHICH COULD BE THE POTENTIAL SOURCE OF THE ANOMALY.

properties.title: NRC Report: Mercury near Las Vegas, NV
properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 724719 - Medium Affected: LAND - Suspected Responsible Party: CLARK COUNTY SCHOOL DISTRICT
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 724719
Incident Time: 2004-06-11 14:00:00
Nearest City: Las Vegas, NV
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: MERCURY
Medium Affected: LAND
Suspected Responsible Party: CLARK COUNTY SCHOOL DISTRICT
Skytruth Analysis
CALLER REPORTED THAT A SPILL OF MERCURY, WHICH OCCURRED ON JUNE 4TH, WAS DISCOVERED ON JUNE 11TH DURING A SUMMERTIME RECREATIONAL PROGAM AT WALTER JOHNSON MIDDLE SCHOOL. ON 04JUN04, A TEACHER WRAPPED A BROKEN BAROMETER IN PLASTIC BAG AND PLACED IT IN A TRASH CAN. WHEN THE TRASH BAG WAS REMOVED, MERCURY BEGAN TO SPILL FROM THE BAG ONTO THE FLOOR. UPON THIS DISCOVERY THE BAG WAS RETURNED TO THE TRASH CAN BUT EVENTUALLY THE CAN AND ALL OF ITS CONTENTS WERE DUMPED INTO A LARGE DUMPSTER OUTSIDE THE SCHOOL. THEN THE MATERIAL WAS SHIPPED BY REPUBLIC SERVICES TO A SANITARY LANDFILL IN APEX,NV. ON 11JUN04, THE PRINCIPAL DISCOVERED KIDS WERE PLAYING GLOBULES OF MERCURY WHICH SPILLED FROM THE BAG AND IT IS BELEIVED THAT MERCURY HAS CONTAMINATED THE SCHOOL AND ITS COURTYARD. HOWEVER, NO INJURIES HAVE BEEN REPORTED.

THE FIRE DEPARTMENT RESPONDED AND COULD NOT FIND THE SOURCE OF THE RELEASE. THE CALL IS CONCERNED THAT THE HOME COULD COMBUST OR EXPLODE BECAUSE THE OWNERS DONT BELIEVE THERE IS AN ISSUE. THE OWNERS OF THE RENTAL SAID THAT THE SMELL WAS COMING FROM SOME SULFURIC ACID THAT WAS LEFT IN A BATH TUB BUT THE CALLER STATES THE SMELL WAS NOT THERE BEFORE. THE FIRE DEPARTMENT TOLD THE RENTERS TO LEAVE THE HOME FOR SAFETY REASONS.
